idea-plugin.name: Batch Cherry-Pick
idea-plugin.description:
Batch Cherry-Pick lets you cherry-pick one or more commits selected in the Git Log onto multiple target branches in a single operation.

  • Select commits in the Git Log, then right-click → Batch Cherry-Pick to Branches...
  • Choose the target branches and execution options (pull, push, dirty worktree, conflict strategy).
  • Commits are applied in topological order to each branch; the original branch is restored afterwards.
